summary: Luda Technology Group, a NYSE American-listed Hong Kong steel pipe maker, disclosed a Form 6-K reporting execution on October 29, 2026 of a share purchase agreement to acquire 55% (5,500 shares) of Asia AI Data Centre Quantum Technology Company Limited from Ms. Liu Liangping, following the June 18, 2026 MOU. Total consideration is US$935,000: US$600,000 cash (US$400,000 paid, US$200,000 due within three months) plus US$335,000 in 91,780 Luda shares at US$3.65, the October 14, 2026 close. The vendor is the spouse of an ultimate beneficial owner/director and a former director, making this a related-party transaction approved by the audit committee under NYSE American Section 120. A separate MOU with Huazhi Future was also announced. Watch related-party governance and AI-pivot execution risk.
